ops.old: Flathead fillets in a crisp lager batter fried golden, with thick double-cooked fries, minted mushy peas and tartare sauce. Cut 1kg potatoes into thick fries and fry at 140C for 6 minutes, then drain. Whisk 200g self-raising flour with 300ml cold lager and salt. Dust 600g flathead fillets in flour, dip in the batter and fry at 180C for 4 minutes until crisp. Fry the fries again at 190C for 3 minutes. Simmer 400g frozen peas for 4 minutes, mash with butter and mint. Serve with tartare and lemon.
